operativeParagraphs.content: Arrest date, arresting or charging law-enforcement agency, and charges/offenses.
Movant states that they have never been convicted of a felony.
60 days have elapsed since the above referenced dismissal and that same dismissal was not in exchange for a guilty plea to another offense.
There are no current charges or proceedings pending relating to the matter.
Prayer for expungement and movant signature.
Certificate of service to the county prosecuting attorney’s office with first class mail, hand delivery, or certified mail – return receipt.

diversionOrDeferred.reason: The queue and packet worklist define a separate WV diversion/deferred family. SCA-C903 has no diversion/deferred or same-transaction paragraph; the separate family requires a supplemental pleading and must distinguish diversion from deferred adjudication.
requiredFacts: Certified dismissal order after full and successful completion
Whether the disposition was pretrial diversion or deferred adjudication

diversionOrDeferred.printedGroundDisposition: If the separate family is owner-released, any C903 ¶2 reason text must remain grounded in the dismissal order and the statutory supplement must carry the missing branch facts. Do not silently classify it as this family’s straight dismissal.
diversionOrDeferred.refusal: If the record only says dismissed and does not establish whether diversion/deferred treatment occurred, refuse and request the dismissal order plus program/order and completion records.

conviction.rule: A conviction takes the W. Va. Code § 61-11-26 route and an applicable SCA-C906 family; do not force a conviction into SCA-C903.

refusalConditions: No certified order or the order does not state whether the case was acquitted or dismissed.
Dismissal date, court type, county, reason, circuit/lower case number, or charge cannot be established from the held record.
Plea-exchange status is unclear after checking the docket/plea agreement.
Prior felony status or current charges/proceedings cannot be established.
A disposition label conflicts with the certified order or indicates diversion/deferred adjudication, a conviction, or a mixed outcome.
Multiple charges would require a same-transaction schedule or supplemental statutory pleading that this family does not currently declare.
participantEvidence: Case/court records for caption and charge facts
unclear.noFallback: No default dismissal election, no heading-based acquittal election, and no inferred plea-exchange answer.
